title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
description: A website designed to help users solve ACM-style programming problems.

features.name: Problem Repository
features.description: A comprehensive collection of ACM-style programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Submission and Evaluation
features.description: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive automated feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: User Profiles and Progress Tracking
features.description: Enables users to create profiles, track their progress, and view their problem-solving history.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance and achievements.

features.name: Hints and Explanations
features.description: Provides hints and detailed explanations for problems to help users learn and improve.

constraints: Must support multiple programming languages for code submission
Requires a scalable backend for handling concurrent users
target_users: Students, competitive programmers, and individuals preparing for ACM competitions
data_requirements: Storage for user profiles, problem data, code submissions, and evaluation results
